title: NGS Library Prep for Targeted Sequencing of DNA Methylation Patterns
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Combine PCR2 aliquots
steps.instruction: For each plate, combine 5 µL of the PCR‑2 product from each of the 96 wells into a single tube, creating one pooled library per plate (or two pools if processing two plates).

steps.title: Pause for manual intervention
steps.instruction: Wait for the OT‑2 robot to signal a pause (deck lights) before proceeding with the bead cleanup.

steps.title: Bead cleanup and transfer
steps.instruction: Perform bead‑based cleanup of each pool according to the EZ DNA Methylation‑Gold Kit protocol, then transfer the cleaned pool to a fresh tube.
